Copies the lobby code to the clipboard when you create an online lobby (host only), so that you can paste it right away.
Looks for updates of the mod on the main menu, for the running version of Among Us.
Also offers the betas of the mod (always with a beta installed).
A new update is available (v{0}). Do you want to download it?
No version for this version of Among Us.
The installer takes over: the game closes and starts again once updated.
Downloads the hats of Better Other Roles when the game starts, when they are missing (CorsacCosmetics). Applied at the next launch.
Shows the name under each hat of Better Other Roles in the hats tab.
Shows the name of a player in the color of their role in the chat, only when you know that role: yourself, a teammate.
Shows the small window of a new message for a few seconds during a game too (the game only shows it in the lobby). The lobby is not changed.
Shows a welcome message in the chat of the first lobby after launching the game.
Shows the summary of the game in the chat when going back to the lobby.

Short: a short line per player (without the killer's name). Normal: the line of the end game screen. Complete: a title per player with the last role, then the roles, tasks, victims and death. /summary also shows it.
Welcome to Better Other Roles v{0}!
The role guide tells you more about the roles and modifiers, and /help in the chat gives the list of commands.
You can turn this message off in your settings (Better Other Roles tab, Chat).
On which players the name is in the color of the role, when you know it. Otherwise the colors of the game: white, impostors in red for an impostor.
On which players the progress is shown with the name: task counter of a crewmate, or the progress of a role. In meetings, your own counter is always shown, except on Never.
Where the role is shown with the name during the game, at the same size. The name does not move.
Where the role is shown with the name in meetings, at the same size. The name does not move.
In meetings, shows (L) after the name of a player with a lighter color, (D) with a darker one. Lighter colors: pink, orange, yellow, white, cyan, lime, rose, banana, coral.
Once dead, you see the task counter of every crewmate, on the players chosen in Progress On Names.
Once dead, you see the role of every player with its name, and in its color with Names In Role Color on Everyone.
Once dead, you see who voted in meetings, even with anonymous votes.
Once dead, you keep the tab of your role under the task list.
Shows the frames per second next to the ping.
Whole seconds as the game, or with a decimal under 10 s or everywhere.
Shows the vents on the map, in the color of their network: the vents of the same color lead to each other.
Once dead, you see all the players on the map, moving as they move; the dead players are faded. Not for the dead impostors, who can still sabotage.
The cams go to the next camera (Polus, Airship) or the next page (The Skeld with more than four cams) by themselves. The left and right move keys (Remap Controls) change it by hand.
How the summary is shown on the end game screen: hidden, in two columns (without the killer's name) or as a full list on the left. The summary button, right of "Quit", also goes from one to the next.
